description: Defines functions for calculating CRB limits for PDSCH grants based on BWP configurations, search space, and DCI formats, following 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: get_ra_crb_limits
methods.description: Calculates CRB limits for PDSCH grant based on DCI format, BWP configurations, search space, and CORESET configuration.

methods.name: get_ra_crb_limits_common
methods.description: Calculates CRB limits for non-UE dedicated allocations like SIB, RAR, SRB0, using initial BWP and search space ID.
